systems.country_label: WAPIS Data Collection and Registration Centre (DACORE)
systems.owner: Government of The Gambia through the Ministry of Interior and the Gambia Police Force; INTERPOL programme funded by the European Union under ECOWAS; memorandum of understanding with INTERPOL signed 19 January 2019
systems.tiers: Centre inaugurated 14 October 2021 at the Joint Operation Center in Banjul, the eighth operational in West Africa; 40 workstations installed in the capital area at Police, Immigration and Drug Law Enforcement Agency premises; 72 people trained in six sessions; INTERPOL said it would add workstations in the centre and across the network of police stations
A connection for WAPIS users in The Gambia was envisaged, not yet made

note: The release describes WAPIS as a centralised national system for collecting, storing and sharing criminal data among agencies and counts workstations in the capital area; it does not say that stations enter reports or cases in it, so the system is unclassified and gives no fact. The EU ambassador asked for a budget heading for the centre by the start of 2022, a request and not a line.
